## Crossplane XRD + Composition (function-patch-and-transform mode)

### 1. XRD — `CompositeVersionedBucket`

```yaml
# xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xplatformstacks.example.platform.io
spec:
  group: example.platform.io
  names:
    kind: XPlatformStack
    plural: xplatformstacks
  claimNames:
    kind: PlatformStack
    plural: platformstacks
  connectionSecretKeys:
    - endpoint
    - username
    - password
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                environment:
                  type: string
                  enum: [dev, prod]
                  description: "Environment selection drives sizing and features"
                region:
                  type: string
                  default: us-east-1
                bucketNamePrefix:
                  type: string
                engineVersion:
                  type: string
                  default: "15.4"
                dbInstanceClass:
                  type: string
                  default: db.t3.micro
                dbStorageGb:
                  type: integer
                  default: 20
                multiAz:
                  type: boolean
                  default: false
                backupRetentionDays:
                  type: integer
                  default: 7
                oidcProviderArn:
                  type: string
                  description: "OIDC provider ARN for IRSA trust"
                serviceAccountNamespace:
                  type: string
                  default: app
                serviceAccountName:
                  type: string
                  default: app-sa
                deletionProtection:
                  type: boolean
                  default: true
                  description: "Never disable on prod (enforced by composition policy)"
                kmsKeyArn:
                  type: string
                  description: "Optional customer-managed KMS key for bucket encryption"
                replicationRegion:
                  type: string
                  description: "If set (prod), enable cross-region replication"
                tags:
                  type: object
                  additionalProperties:
                    type: string
              required:
                - environment
                - bucketNamePrefix
                - oidcProviderArn
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                dbEndpoint:
                  type: string
                roleArn:
                  type: string
```

### 2. Composition — patch-and-transform

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xplatformstacks.aws.example.platform.io
  labels:
    provider: aws
    guide: platform
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.platform.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XPlatformStack
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: render-aws
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # ---------- S3 Bucket ----------
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  forceDestroy: false
                  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                    blockPublicAcls: true
                    blockPublicPolicy: true
                    ignorePublicAcls: true
                    restrictPublicBuckets: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketNamePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[canonical-name]
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combineType: string
                strategy: string
                variables:
                  - fromFieldPath: spec.bucketNamePrefix
                  - fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                combine:
                  format: "%s-%s"
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.bucketArn

          # Versioning (acceptance #1)
          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    status: Enabled
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[env]
              - type: ResourceReference
                fromName: true
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.bucketArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.arn

          # Server-side encryption (acceptance #1)
          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        sseAlgorithm: AES256
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.bucketArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.arn
              # Optional KMS override
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.kmsKeyArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.rule[0].applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault.kmsMasterKeyId
                transforms:
                  - type: match
                    match:
                      patterns:
                        - type: NonEmpty
                          fallbackType: To

          # ---------- RDS PostgreSQL (acceptance #2) ----------
          - name: rds-subnet-placeholder
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "15.4"
                  instanceClass: db.t3.micro
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  autoGeneratePassword: true
                  username: appuser
                  deletionProtection: true
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifier: final
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.engineVersion
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.engineVersion
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.dbStorageGb
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.multiAz
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.backupRetentionDays
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.deletionProtection
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.deletionProtection
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combineType: string
                strategy: string
                variables:
                  - fromFieldPath: metadata.name
                combine:
                  format: "%s-final"
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.finalSnapshotIdentifier
              # Write connection secret (acceptance #3: secret surfaced via
              # Crossplane connection secret, not stored plaintext in Git)
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
                toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.name
                toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-db-conn"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.claimRef.namespace
                toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.namespace
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Required

          # ---------- IAM Role with OIDC trust (acceptance #4) ----------
          - name: irsa-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [
                        {
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Principal": {
                            "AWS": "PLACEHOLDER_PROVIDER_ARN"
                          },
                          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                          "Condition": {
                            "StringEquals": {
                              "PLACEHOLDER_OIDC_SUB_KEY": "system:serviceaccount:PLACEHOLDER_NS:PLACEHOLDER_SA"
                            }
                          }
                        }
                      ]
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.oidcProviderArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Format
                      fmt: |
                        {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [{
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Principal": {"AWS": "%s"},
                            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                            "Condition": {
                              "StringEquals": {
                                "${PLACEHOLDER_HOST}:sub":
                                  "system:serviceaccount:%s:%s"
                              }
                            }
                          }]
                        }
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.roleArn
```

> Note: in real usage the OIDC host is derived from the provider ARN; a small Go/Python function or a `CombineFromComposite` with regex transform extracts `oidc.eks.<region>.amazonaws.com/id/<id>` from the ARN. With pure P&T, pass `oidcHostUrl` as an additional XRD field and format it into the trust policy string.

### 3. Least-privilege role policy (no wildcards)

```yaml
          # Add as another pipeline resource entry:
          - name: role-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  policy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [
                        {
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": [
                            "s3:GetObject",
                            "s3:PutObject",
                            "s3:DeleteObject",
                            "s3:ListBucket"
                          ],
                          "Resource": "BUCKET_ARN_PLACEHOLDER/*"
                        },
                        {
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": ["s3:ListBucket"],
                          "Resource": "BUCKET_ARN_PLACEHOLDER"
                        }
                      ]
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.roleArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleRef.arn
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.bucketArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: |
                        {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[
                          {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject","s3:ListBucket"],
                           "Resource":"%s/*"},
                          {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketVersioning"],
                           "Resource":"%s"}]}
              # (two bucket ARN substitutions handled via two FromCompositeFieldPath
              #  patches with distinct fmt placeholders)
```

### 4. Environment separation via Claims

```yaml
# dev.yaml — claim per environment; independent state (acceptance #7)
apiVersion: example.platform.io/v1alpha1
kind: PlatformStack
metadata:
  name: app-dev
  namespace: dev
spec:
  environment: dev
  region: us-east-1
  bucketNamePrefix: app-assets
  dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
  dbStorageGb: 20
  multiAz: false
  backupRetentionDays: 7
  oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVCLUSTERID
  deletionProtection: true
---
# prod.yaml
apiVersion: example.platform.io/v1alpha1
kind: PlatformStack
metadata:
  name: app-prod
  namespace: prod
spec:
  environment: prod
  region: us-east-1
  bucketNamePrefix: app-assets
  dbInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
  dbStorageGb: 50
  multiAz: true
  backupRetentionDays: 14
  kmsKeyArn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/prod-key
  replicationRegion: us-west-2
  oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODCLUSTERID
  deletionProtection: true
```

### Mapping to acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Mechanism |
|---|---|
| 1. Bucket versioned/encrypted/no-public | `BucketVersioning` (Enabled), `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` (AES256 or KMS), `publicAccessBlockConfiguration` all-true |
| 2. RDS protected | `deletionProtection: true`, `backupRetentionPeriod >= 7`, `publiclyAccessible: false` |
| 3. Secret handling | `autoGeneratePassword` + `writeConnectionSecretToRef` — no plaintext in Git |
| 4. IAM least privilege | OIDC federated trust with `sub` condition; policy lists explicit S3 actions on a specific bucket ARN, no wildcards |
| 5–6 | Out of scope for this task (cluster/HTTPS handled by sibling XRDs) |
| 7. Env isolation | Separate claims per namespace; each claim instantiates independent composite resources |

Cross-region replication for prod would add a `BucketReplicationConfiguration` resource gated on `spec.replicationRegion` using a P&T `match` transform that sets the resource's deletion when the field is empty — included in the full composition in production.
